end.summary:
Physical and chemical changes were practised with everyday examples.
Ananya identified melting wax as physical and burning the wick as chemical.
They named gas, colour change, light, and new substances as chemical-change clues.
They distinguished dissolving sugar or salt from melting and noted that dissolved substances remain present.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconception was recorded.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying physical and chemical changes using wax, a burning wick, rusting iron, soda, salt, and sugar. They used the method of checking whether a new substance forms and correctly noted that melting can be reversed, while burning produces ash and smoke. They also explained that dissolved salt or sugar is still present, though they asked for visual demonstrations several times. At home, try sorting household examples into “melting,” “dissolving,” and “new substance formed,” and ask Ananya to explain the clue for each.

wax pighalna physical hai... kyunki yeh wapas jam sakta hai, jaise mummy ne kiya tha... aur baati jalna chemical hai, kyunki new substance banta hai... jaise raakh aur smoke... lekin raakh actual mein dikhao na, screen pe kuch nahi hai!

Haan, wax pighalna physical aur baati jalna chemical hai. Baati ki raakh nayi cheez ka saboot hai; wax ke liye ek baat aur jodni hai: pighalne par woh wax hi rehta hai. Raakh ki photo abhi nahi dikha sakti; sochiye baati ke sire par kaala, bhur-bhura powder. Ab namak paani mein milaane par, woh pighalta hai ya ghulta hai, aur farq kya hai?

ghulta hai... pata hai, ek baar maine glass mein namak daala tha aur hilaya toh gayab ho gaya, lekin paani salty tha, toh woh abhi bhi hai na? pighalna matlab jaise ice cream dhoop mein rakho toh liquid ban jaati hai, usmein nayi cheez nahi banti... lekin namak wapas kaise laayein? dikhao na, paani se namak alag karke dikhao

Haan, namak ghulta hai, pighalta nahi; paani salty hai, matlab namak abhi bhi usmein hai. Asli demo ya photo abhi nahi dikha sakti. Board par dekhiye: paani dheere dheere bhaap ban kar ude, toh namak bartan mein bach jaata hai. Ab paani mein cheeni gholne par glass ka wazan badhega, utna hi rahega ya ghatega?
badhega! kyunki cheeni toh andar gayi na, chhup gayi bas, udd thodi gayi... jaise namak wala scene tha, paani salty tha matlab namak tha... lekin actual taraazu dikhao na, please!

Bilkul, wazan badhega: cheeni dikh nahi rahi, par glass mein hi hai. Asli taraazu abhi dikha nahi sakti; sochiye, cheeni daalne ke baad uski sui zyada wazan dikhati hai. Ab ek drink mein cheeni room-temperature paani mein ghulti hai, aur doosri mein chocolate garam hokar liquid banti hai. Inmein kya ghul raha hai aur kya pighal raha hai?

sugar wala toh dissolving hai na, kyunki woh gayab ho gaya paani mein... lekin abhi bhi hai, jaise namak wala salty tha waise sweet hoga drink... aur chocolate wala pighal raha hai, kyunki woh liquid ban gaya bas, gas pe garam karne se... lekin chocolate dikhao na, liquid chocolate kaisi dikhti hai, please!

Aapne cheeni ke paani mein rehne aur chocolate ke liquid banne ki baat ki. Liquid chocolate ki photo abhi nahi dikha sakti; sochiye, chamach se dheere behne wali gaadhi, bhoori chocolate. Ab garmi mein doodh khatta hokar phat jaaye, toh woh physical change hai ya chemical, aur kya saboot hai?

c7-science-ch05-t01-s2.evidence: Iron se alag gunon wali nayi parat ko chemical change kaha; verified correct.

c7-science-ch05-t01-s3.evidence: Wax aur baati sahi pehchane; wax ke liye reversibility batayi, nayi substance na banne ka saboot nahi diya.

c7-science-ch05-t01-s4.evidence: Verified correct: cheeni ghulne par wazan badhta hai kyunki woh paani mein rehti hai.
